parties: Pathirannehelage Seetha Pathirana Petitioner Vs. Commissioner General of Lands and Others Pathirannehelage Seetha Pathirana Petitioner Vs. Commissioner General of Lands and Others View More
judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Petitioner sought the intervention of this Court to compel the Respondents to issue a permit in terms of the State Lands Ordinance in respect of the land in suit in favour of the Petitioner according to the reports and recommendation made by the Respondents that was unsuccessfully challenged by the 6th Respondent in a previous separate application; 3rd Respondent had taken steps to issue permit in respect of the same land in favour of the 6th Respondent, contradictory to the initial report and recommendation of the 2nd Respondent. Held – Due to insufficient evidence to prove the 6th Respondent had effected improvements to the land and was entitled to the premises in suit, Writs issued. 2 nd to 5th Respondents have failed to follow instructions of the 1st Respondent authority which has led to the contradictory and capricious decisions of the 2nd and 3rd Respondents.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
